title: Think Wider: Mitigating Latent Rank Collapse in Implicit Chain-of-Thought Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2609.07406v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning improves the reasoning ability of large language models by introducing intermediate computation, but explicit rationales increase decoding length, latency, and context cost. Implicit CoT offers a more efficient alternative by moving intermediate reasoning into continuous latent states. However, latent reasoning can be unstable: successive latent states may become overly similar and collapse toward a shared dominant direction, reducing the diversity of the reasoning trajectory. In this work, we identify $\textit{latent rank collapse}$ and propose $\textbf{WIDER}$, a lightweight spectral regularizer for implicit CoT. During training, WIDER estimates the shared direction of each latent trajectory and penalizes projections onto this direction, encouraging latent states to span a broader representational subspace. translated_title: 拓宽思考：缓解隐式思维链推理中的潜在秩坍缩问题
translated_abstract: 链式思维推理通过引入中间计算提升了大语言模型的推理能力，但显式的推理过程会增加解码长度、延迟和上下文成本。隐式CoT通过将中间推理迁移到连续潜在状态中，提供了一种更高效的替代方案。然而，潜在推理可能不稳定：连续的潜在状态可能变得过于相似，并向一个共享的主导方向坍缩，从而降低推理轨迹的多样性。在本工作中，我们识别了“潜在秩坍缩”现象，并提出了WIDER——一种面向隐式CoT的轻量级谱正则化方法。在训练过程中，WIDER估计每个潜在轨迹的共享方向，并惩罚向该方向的投影，鼓励潜在状态跨越更广泛的表示子空间。该方法是即插即用的，不改变骨干模型、潜在调度和推理时的解码过程（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 提出WIDER——一种即插即用的轻量级谱正则化方法，通过惩罚潜在状态向共享主导方向的投影来缓解隐式思维链推理中的潜在秩坍缩问题，使潜在状态扩展到更广泛的表示子空间并提升推理多样性。
en_tdlr: Proposes WIDER, a lightweight plug-and-play spectral regularizer that mitigates latent rank collapse in implicit chain-of-thought reasoning by penalizing projections onto the shared dominant direction, encouraging latent states to span a broader representational subspace and improving reasoning diversity.
